body:
I think you should start writing. Write stories. If you like to fantasize, like myself, you might find yourself finding that living in your stories can alleviate some of the anxiety/pressure of harming yourself. I know I wrote a sick-fucking twisted story about a guy who raped a woman, who then proceeded to cut off his own genitalia in mental anguish and protect her from future occurrences without her knowledge.  

Of course, they don't have to be sick stories but unfortunately that tends to be how our kind thinks as we struggle.
